sentences.text: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad, born in 1966, holds a Bachelor of Business Administration from Universidad Anahuac Mexico, and has served as a director and member of the executive committee of America Movil since 2000, with his principal occupation listed as the company's chief executive officer.

sentences.quote: In 1997, he was appointed Chief Executive Officer of Telcel and during his administration, America Movil was established as a result of the spin-off from Telmex.
sentences.text: Earlier in his career he held senior roles at BIMEX, Dulces y Chocolates LUXUS, Artes Graficas Unidas, Galas de Mexico and Euskadi General Tire, before being appointed chief executive officer of Telcel in 1997, during which time America Movil was created through a spin-off from Telmex.
America Movil's regulatory filings confirm his appointment as chief executive officer in 2000 and prior experience as a director of Telmex and chief executive of Compania Hulera Euzkadi.

mgmt_bio.text: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad, born in 1966, holds a Bachelor of Business Administration from Universidad Anahuac Mexico, and has served as a director and member of the executive committee of America Movil since 2000, with his principal occupation listed as the company's chief executive officer. Earlier in his career he held senior roles at BIMEX, Dulces y Chocolates LUXUS, Artes Graficas Unidas, Galas de Mexico and Euskadi General Tire, before being appointed chief executive officer of Telcel in 1997, during which time America Movil was created through a spin-off from Telmex. He also sits on the boards of Telmex, Carso Global Telecom and Grupo Carso.

sentences.quote: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad (CEO) has led America Movil since 2000, making him one of the longest-tenured telecom CEOs globally.
sentences.text: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad has led America Movil since 2000, one of the longest tenures in global telecom, overseeing its growth into the largest telecom operator in Latin America.

Capital allocation has been steady and cash-flow funded: dividends of Ps.33.2 billion in 2025 and Ps.11.9 billion of open-market buybacks that year, with leverage managed to a 1.2x-1.5x net debt to EBITDA range and 1.31x reported at end-June 2026.

sentences.quote: Hajj said the company remains on track for about $7 billion in full-year capital expenditures.
sentences.text: Recent strategy favors roughly $7 billion of annual capex and fiber-adding acquisitions inside existing markets rather than new-country expansion.
Governance sits under founder-family control, with the board and audit and corporate practices committee ratified by shareholders.

sentences.text: America Movil operates at continental scale, ending March 2026 with 414 million access lines, including 334 million wireless subscribers, 37 million broadband accesses, 14 million Pay TV units and 29 million landlines.

sentences.quote: Management said mobile postpaid and fixed broadband remained the main sources of customer growth, rising 9.1% and 6.1%, respectively, from the year-earlier quarter.
sentences.text: The mix keeps shifting toward higher-value services: it added 3.5 million postpaid subscribers in the second quarter of 2026, with mobile postpaid and fixed broadband bases up 9.1% and 6.1% year on year.

sentences.quote: Mobile service revenue grew 6.5%, continuing its recent pace. Postpaid revenue expanded 7.2%, while prepaid revenue growth accelerated to 5.3% from 3.1% a year earlier.
sentences.text: Pricing and usage support revenue, as mobile service revenue grew 6.5% while postpaid revenue rose 7.2% and prepaid growth accelerated to 5.3%.

sentences.quote: second-quarter revenue rose 3.1% year over year in Mexican peso terms to MXN 241 billion. Service revenue increased 3.4%, while EBITDA rose 3.8%. At constant exchange rates, service revenue grew 5.1% and EBITDA increased 5.3%
sentences.text: Operating leverage and cash generation are improving, with second-quarter 2026 revenue of 241 billion Mexican pesos, EBITDA up 5.3% at constant exchange rates and operating profit of 51.8 billion pesos, up 9.5%.

sentences.quote: Garcia Moreno said the company added 3.5 million postpaid subscribers in the quarter, led by Brazil with 1.5 million additions. Colombia added 250,000 postpaid subscribers, Peru 173,000, Argentina 154,000
sentences.text: Growth is geographically diversified across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Peru, Argentina and Eastern Europe, cushioning single-market competitive pressure.

thesis_pillars.text: The mix keeps shifting toward higher-value services: it added 3.5 million postpaid subscribers in the second quarter of 2026, with mobile postpaid and fixed broadband bases up 9.1% and 6.1% year on year. Pricing and usage support revenue, as mobile service revenue grew 6.5% while postpaid revenue rose 7.2% and prepaid growth accelerated to 5.3%. Operating leverage and cash generation are improving, with second-quarter 2026 revenue of 241 billion Mexican pesos, EBITDA up 5.3% at constant exchange rates and operating profit of 51.8 billion pesos, up 9.5%. Growth is geographically diversified across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Peru, Argentina and Eastern Europe, cushioning single-market competitive pressure.
